fine_trace.note: The HTTP/1 request bytes supply the method HEAD and path /reproxy-test into the request object used by the real server implementation.
The input-controlled HEAD method is recorded in the proxy generator, causing the proxied response to be treated as a response without body bytes for the downstream request.
The reverse proxy emits an empty in-progress send to flush only response headers before the upstream response is complete.
The empty proxy send propagates bufcnt equal to 0 into the generic send path.

For a HEAD response, setup_chunked did not allocate chunked_buf; after headers have been sent, an empty body send therefore has no header vector, no body vector, and no chunked terminator to keep bufcnt positive.
